roles:
CREATE TABLE roles (
	role_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	role_name VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (role_id), 
	UNIQUE (role_name)
)
status:
CREATE TABLE status (
	status_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status_name VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (status_id), 
	UNIQUE (status_name)
)
service_categories:
CREATE TABLE service_categories (
	category_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	category_name VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (category_id), 
	UNIQUE (category_name)
)
conditions:
CREATE TABLE conditions (
	condition_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	condition_name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (condition_id), 
	UNIQUE (condition_name)
)
payment_methods:
CREATE TABLE payment_methods (
	method_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	method_name VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (method_id), 
	UNIQUE (method_name)
)
payment_statuses:
CREATE TABLE payment_statuses (
	p_status_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status_name VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (p_status_id), 
	UNIQUE (status_name)
)
shipping_preferences:
CREATE TABLE shipping_preferences (
	pref_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	pref_name VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (pref_id), 
	UNIQUE (pref_name)
)
priority_levels:
CREATE TABLE priority_levels (
	priority_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	priority_name VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (priority_id), 
	UNIQUE (priority_name)
)
customers:
CREATE TABLE customers (
	customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	customer_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	contact_number VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP, 
	PRIMARY KEY (customer_id)
)
inventory:
CREATE TABLE inventory (
	item_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	item_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	category VARCHAR(50), 
	stock_quantity FLOAT, 
	unit VARCHAR(20), 
	unit_price DECIMAL(10, 2), 
	status VARCHAR(30), 
	is_active BOOLEAN, 
	auto_deduct BOOLEAN, 
	auto_deduct_trigger VARCHAR(50), 
	trigger_service VARCHAR(100), 
	consumption_qty FLOAT, 
	consumption_unit VARCHAR(20), 
	package_size FLOAT, 
	package_unit VARCHAR(20), 
	low_stock_threshold FLOAT, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP, 
	PRIMARY KEY (item_id), 
	UNIQUE (item_name)
)
etl_import_history:
CREATE TABLE etl_import_history (
	import_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	filename VARCHAR(255), 
	records_read INTEGER, 
	records_imported INTEGER, 
	duplicates_removed INTEGER, 
	invalid_records INTEGER, 
	import_started TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	import_finished TIMESTAMP, 
	duration_seconds FLOAT, 
	imported_by VARCHAR(100), 
	status VARCHAR(20), 
	error_message TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (import_id)
)
users:
CREATE TABLE users (
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	username VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	email VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	password_hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	role_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOLEAN, 
	failed_login_attempts INTEGER, 
	locked_until DATETIME, 
	reset_token VARCHAR(255), 
	reset_token_expiry DATETIME, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP, 
	PRIMARY KEY (user_id), 
	UNIQUE (email), 
	FOREIGN KEY(role_id) REFERENCES roles (role_id)
)
services:
CREATE TABLE services (
	service_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	service_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	base_price DECIMAL(10, 2) NOT NULL, 
	category_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT, 
	duration_days INTEGER, 
	service_code VARCHAR(20), 
	is_active BOOLEAN, 
	sort_order INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (service_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(category_id) REFERENCES service_categories (category_id)
)
expenses:
CREATE TABLE expenses (
	expense_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	amount DECIMAL(10, 2) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT, 
	expense_date DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP, 
	PRIMARY KEY (expense_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (user_id)
)
orders:
CREATE TABLE orders (
	order_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	order_number VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	priority_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	grand_total DECIMAL(10, 2) NOT NULL, 
	rush_reduction_days INTEGER, 
	expected_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	released_at DATETIME, 
	claimed_at DATETIME, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	inventory_applied BOOLEAN, 
	inventory_used JSON, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP, 
	PRIMARY KEY (order_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(customer_id) REFERENCES customers (customer_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(status_id) REFERENCES status (status_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(priority_id) REFERENCES priority_levels (priority_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (user_id)
)
audit_logs:
CREATE TABLE audit_logs (
	audit_log_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER, 
	username VARCHAR(50), 
	role VARCHAR(20), 
	action_type VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	module VARCHAR(50), 
	table_name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	record_id INTEGER, 
	old_values JSON, 
	new_values JSON, 
	ip_address VARCHAR(50), 
	user_agent VARCHAR(255), 
	created_at TIMESTAMP, 
	PRIMARY KEY (audit_log_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (user_id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)
historical_images:
CREATE TABLE historical_images (
	historical_image_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	historical_order_id INTEGER, 
	image_filename VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	image_path VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	image_hash VARCHAR(64), 
	ocr_confidence FLOAT, 
	ocr_status VARCHAR(50), 
	ocr_version VARCHAR(50), 
	uploaded_at TIMESTAMP, 
	processed_at TIMESTAMP, 
	PRIMARY KEY (historical_image_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(historical_order_id) REFERENCES "historical_orders_old" (historical_order_id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)
historical_items:
CREATE TABLE historical_items (
	historical_item_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	historical_order_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	brand VARCHAR(50), 
	model VARCHAR(50), 
	color VARCHAR(50), 
	size VARCHAR(20), 
	material VARCHAR(50), 
	priority VARCHAR(30), 
	remarks TEXT, 
	scratches BOOLEAN, 
	yellowing BOOLEAN, 
	sole_separation BOOLEAN, 
	deep_stains BOOLEAN, 
	rips_holes BOOLEAN, 
	worn_out BOOLEAN, item_price DECIMAL(10,2) NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (historical_item_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(historical_order_id) REFERENCES "historical_orders_old" (historical_order_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
historical_predictions:
CREATE TABLE historical_predictions (
	prediction_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	historical_order_id INTEGER, 
	predicted_completion_days INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	predicted_release_date DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	actual_completion_days INTEGER, 
	prediction_error FLOAT, 
	prediction_date TIMESTAMP, 
	algorithm VARCHAR(50), 
	model_version VARCHAR(30), 
	input_snapshot JSON, 
	PRIMARY KEY (prediction_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(historical_order_id) REFERENCES "historical_orders_old" (historical_order_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
payments:
CREATE TABLE payments (
	payment_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	order_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	method_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	amount_received DECIMAL(10, 2), 
	balance DECIMAL(10, 2), 
	reference_no VARCHAR(100), 
	deposit_amount DECIMAL(10, 2), 
	created_at TIMESTAMP, 
	PRIMARY KEY (payment_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(order_id) REFERENCES orders (order_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(method_id) REFERENCES payment_methods (method_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(status_id) REFERENCES payment_statuses (p_status_id)
)
deliveries:
CREATE TABLE deliveries (
	delivery_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	order_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	pref_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	delivery_address TEXT, 
	delivery_courier VARCHAR(50), 
	release_time VARCHAR(20), 
	province VARCHAR(100), 
	city VARCHAR(100), 
	barangay VARCHAR(100), 
	zip_code VARCHAR(20), 
	PRIMARY KEY (delivery_id), 
	UNIQUE (order_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(order_id) REFERENCES orders (order_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(pref_id) REFERENCES shipping_preferences (pref_id)
)
items:
CREATE TABLE items (
	item_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	order_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	brand VARCHAR(50), 
	material VARCHAR(50), 
	shoe_model VARCHAR(50), 
	shoe_size VARCHAR(20), 
	color VARCHAR(50), 
	quantity INTEGER, 
	item_notes TEXT, 
	inventory_used JSON, 
	PRIMARY KEY (item_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(order_id) REFERENCES orders (order_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
status_log:
CREATE TABLE status_log (
	status_log_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	order_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	changed_at TIMESTAMP, 
	PRIMARY KEY (status_log_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(order_id) REFERENCES orders (order_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(status_id) REFERENCES status (status_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (user_id)
)
inventory_logs:
CREATE TABLE inventory_logs (
	log_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	item_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	change_amount FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	action_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	order_id INTEGER, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP, 
	PRIMARY KEY (log_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(item_id) REFERENCES inventory (item_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(order_id) REFERENCES orders (order_id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (user_id)
)
historical_item_services:
CREATE TABLE historical_item_services (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	historical_item_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	service_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	service_type VARCHAR(20), 
	price DECIMAL(10, 2), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(historical_item_id) REFERENCES historical_items (historical_item_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
item_service_mapping:
CREATE TABLE item_service_mapping (
	item_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	service_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	actual_price DECIMAL(10, 2) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (item_id, service_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(item_id) REFERENCES items (item_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(service_id) REFERENCES services (service_id)
)
item_condition_mapping:
CREATE TABLE item_condition_mapping (
	item_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	condition_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (item_id, condition_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(item_id) REFERENCES items (item_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(condition_id) REFERENCES conditions (condition_id)
)
historical_orders:
CREATE TABLE historical_orders (
                historical_order_id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                order_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
                customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                branch VARCHAR(100),
                date_received DATETIME NOT NULL,
                original_estimated_release_date DATETIME,
                claimed_date DATETIME,
                completion_days INTEGER,
                total_pairs INTEGER,
                grand_total DECIMAL(10, 2) NOT NULL,
                downpayment DECIMAL(10, 2),
                balance DECIMAL(10, 2),
                priority VARCHAR(30),
                payment_method VARCHAR(50),
                sync_status VARCHAR(20),
                ocr_status VARCHAR(50),
                audit_trail JSON,
                created_at TIMESTAMP,
                updated_at TIMESTAMP,
                FOREIGN KEY(customer_id) REFERENCES customers (customer_id)
            )
